rationale: Both candidates independently surface the PR's central ground-truth thread (platform-wide vllm_c default validated only on Qwen-Image, and the irony that Part 2's nn.RMSNorm swap means Part 1 no longer even affects Qwen-Image) with strong, diff-grounded evidence, plus overlapping secondary catches (ROCm/XPU left on old logic, module-scope CUDA import breaking non-CUDA collection, missing UT for Part 2). Y edges recall/actionability with a near-verbatim match to NumberWan's affected-model list and cleaner, more surgical findings, but its 'What I verified' section makes unfalsifiable claims (running pytest on a named GPU, exact kernel-vs-native numeric diffs) that read as fabricated and undercut its confident Part-2 approval. X stays more disciplined with grep/file:line-grounded evidence throughout, but one 'major' finding (claiming with_default silently flips untouched IrOpPriorityConfig fields) appears to misstate the config's actual field count, weakening precision. Net effect is a wash.
